when dword `rcx+0xe0` is 1 calls `00123D40(rcx)` first; then makes the call at `00124010`+0x25 on `rcx` and the call at `00124010`+0x34 (`rcx`, `rdx`), returning the first nonzero result of the three; when all succeed it changes dword `rcx+0xe0` from 0xA to 0xB and returns 0
